source_units: is a free IR-inspired algorithmic reverb that turns captured spaces into editable size, density, width, clarity, and motion controls. It uses impulse-response analysis as a starting point, then lets you keep shaping the space inside a mix instead of staying trapped inside one fixed convolution snapshot.
What Propagation is, in one sentence
Propagation analyzes a captured space, then turns it into a playable algorithmic reverb.
If you prefer a simpler mental model, think of it like this:
Propagation gives you playable controls over size, density, width, clarity, and motion
AAX / AU / VST3 for macOS 11 or later
